definitions.explanation: A person who hunts wild animals for a living. A literary or old-fashioned word, seen in folk tales, novels and song lyrics; also read かりうど.

examples.japanese: {狩人|かりゅうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The hunter went into the forest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狩人|かりゅうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Hunters often appear in old folk tales.

examples.japanese: {狩人|かりゅうど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{足跡|あしあと}→足跡：04095_ashiato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たどって、⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}いかけた→追いかける：16734_oikakeru⟧。
examples.english: Following the footprints in the snow, the hunter tracked the herd of deer.

notes:
Also read かりうど. In everyday modern Japanese, a hunter is usually ⟦{猟師|りょうし}→猟師：19613_ryoushi⟧ or ハンター; {狩人|かりゅうど} has an old-fashioned, storybook feel.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{猟師|りょうし}→猟師：19613_ryoushi⟧: hunter (the ordinary word for someone who hunts for a living)
- ハンター: hunter; also used figuratively, as in a bargain hunter
- ⟦{狩|か}り→狩り：02689_kari⟧: hunting
